title: Founder Fridays
description: Weekly founder talks featuring successful entrepreneurs sharing their journey, lessons learned, and practical advice for aspiring founders. Each session includes a 45-minute talk followed by open Q&A and networking.

title: Investor Connect
description: Exclusive networking session with VCs and angel investors. Learn what investors look for in early-stage startups, pitch deck essentials, term sheet fundamentals, and how to approach fundraising strategically. Includes structured 1-on-1 office hours.

title: Pitch Nexus
description: IIM Bodh Gaya's flagship startup pitch competition. Early-stage startups compete for prize money, mentorship, and investor introductions. Judged by a panel of VCs, founders, and industry experts. Open to all students and recent alumni.

title: Build Weekend
description: 48-hour intensive build sprint where teams conceive, prototype, and validate a startup idea. Mentors guide participants through ideation, MVP development, user testing, and pitch preparation. Ends with a demo showcase and feedback session.

title: Startup Sprint
description: Week-long startup challenge where teams go from problem discovery to validated business model. Daily workshops on customer discovery, business model canvas, financial modeling, and growth strategies. Final pitch to a panel of investors and operators.

title: Innovation Lab
description: Hands-on innovation sessions covering design thinking, rapid prototyping, no-code tools, and emerging tech (AI, blockchain, IoT). Each session tackles a real industry problem statement. Build tangible prototypes and learn innovation frameworks used by top companies.

title: Demo Day
description: Cohort showcase featuring startups from the Build Weekend and Startup Sprint programs. Founders present their ventures to an audience of investors, mentors, peers, and industry leaders. Includes networking reception and investor matchmaking.
